synthesis.evidence_balance: mixed — chronic cash burn and dilution against narrowing losses, a forward-multiple premium, and unverified management profitability guidance pulling opposite directions.

bull_points.claim: On the LTM forward revenue multiple the name trades at NTM TEV/Rev 0.36 against a peer Low of 0.62, Median 2.07, and High 8.42 — a steep discount that the human must decompose against fundamentals rather than accept at face value.
bull_points.source_ref: CIQ Comparable Analysis→Trading Multiples (name row + Summary Statistics Low/Median/Mean/High)

bull_points.claim: On the decomposition inputs the discount looks partly RESIDUAL rather than fully EARNED: the name's revenue growth is 22% versus a peer-median 9% with a beta of 2.4 versus peer-median 1.4 — superior top-line growth alongside higher risk, the human judges which dominates.

bull_points.claim: Absolute revenue scaled steadily from 3,419 (Oct-2022) to 5,304 (LTM Mar-2026) while ROIC improved from -11.2% to -3.3%, so the operating loss is narrowing even as the headline stays negative — read the % alongside the rising absolute base.

The decline is idiosyncratic, not a market move: the name returned -72.6% over 180d while IWM returned +18.0%, a relative -89.0% — the market is repricing this name specifically.
Three discrete gap-downs cluster on earnings 8-Ks (2026-02-03 and 2026-05-06 both item 2.02 Results of Operations), so the de-rating is anchored to reported results, not a transient shock.
